# Agent Skills Setup (skills-repo) Full Documentation

> Offline, previewed, and rollback-safe migration of AI coding context (Skills, Rules, Instructions, and MCP) across Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Windsurf, Copilot, and Gemini CLI.

- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo
- **Author**: Luckycat133
- **Version**: 0.10.2
- **License**: MIT
- **Registry**: ClawHub (`@luckycat133/agent-skills-setup`)

---

## 1. Overview & Supported IDE Matrix

Agent Skills Setup harmonizes AI coding context across disparate IDE configurations:

| IDE / Agent | Skills | Rules / Instructions | MCP Server Config | Support Level |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cursor** | `.cursor/skills` | `.cursorrules` / `.cursor/rules` | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` | Full |
| **Claude Code** | `.claude/skills` | `CLAUDE.md` | `~/.claude/settings.json` | Full |
| **Codex** | `.codex/skills` | `AGENTS.md` | `~/.codex/config.toml` | Full |
| **Windsurf** | Native skills | `.windsurfrules` | Native MCP | Full |
| **Cline / Roo Code** | Native skills | `.clinerules` | `cline_mcp_settings.json` | Full |
| **GitHub Copilot** | Copilot instructions | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | VS Code settings | Full |
| **Gemini CLI / Antigravity** | `.gemini/skills` | `GEMINI.md` | `mcp_config.json` | Full |

---

## 2. Quick Installation & Invocation

```bash
# Via ClawHub / OpenClaw
openclaw skills install @luckycat133/agent-skills-setup

# Or via GitHub direct clone
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo.git
```

### Natural Language Prompts (Say this to your AI Agent)
- *"Migrate Skills, rules, and MCP from Cursor in this project to Claude Code."*
- *"Back up all portable AI coding setup from my installed IDEs to an ACB bundle."*
- *"Restore this ACB bundle to the installed IDEs on my new computer."*

---

## 3. Core Safety & Rollback Architecture

1. **Secret Redaction**: High-entropy tokens, API keys (`*_KEY`, `*_SECRET`), and bearer tokens are automatically sanitized into placeholder tokens inside portable ACB bundles.
2. **Interactive Preview**: Migration operations generate a unified preview diff (`migration-plan.md`) requiring explicit user approval before modifying files.
3. **Automated Rollback**: Snapshots are persisted prior to writing changes, enabling instant 1-click rollback.
